samples.stimulus: In a survey about a proposed library, a random sample of residents was selected. The sample percent was 50 percent, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points. The plausible interval for the percent of all residents of Millbrook who support building a new library is the sample percent plus or minus the margin of error. The graphs are shown on number lines below. Answer the question using only the number line shown.
samples.question: Which of the following graphs shows the plausible interval?
samples.explanation: (1) 표본 % = 50, 오차범위 = 3 이다. (2) 구간 = 50 ± 3 = 47 ~ 53 이다. (3) 결과를 그림과 다시 대조해 확인한다. (4) 결과를 그림과 다시 대조해 확인한다. (5) 따라서 답은 47% ~ 53% 이다. 따라서 정답은 D이다.
